# Representative corrected PRD journey and metric block

Corrected shape for FR1–FR4: named protagonist with inline context, ordered path,
climax, success exit, failure path, evidence status with gap recorded when
illustrative, and counter-metric pairing.

## User Journeys

- J1 — Journey: Mary re-enrolls during the school run
  - Trigger and context: Mary, mom of three, gets the re-enrollment email while waiting in the school pickup line — two minutes of attention, one hand on the phone.
  - Steps: (1) Mary opens the email link, already signed in from last year. (2) The form pre-fills each child's details from the prior year; she only confirms what changed. (3) She submits and sees confirmation for all three children at once.
  - Climax and success exit: The confirmation screen names each child with their updated details — the moment she knows she is done for all three, not just one. Success exit: no follow-up email needed.
  - Failure path: The pre-fill shows a stale address; Mary edits it for one child and the other two do not inherit the change — she must repeat the edit and risks submitting inconsistent records. Recovery: a one-tap "apply to all children" action.
  - Evidence: Illustrative — evidence gap: no firsthand account of a re-enrollment session has been supplied yet.
  - Reveals: FR1–FR4.

## Success Measures & Counter-Metrics

- **Form completion rate:** Percentage of started re-enrollments submitted for all children in one session.
  - **Counter-metric:** Single-child submissions that force a second session — fires when completion is "improved" by letting parents submit partial enrollments that count as complete.
